title: George H.W. Bush, George W. Bush and Cheney's role in the legacy program

tellings.quote: George HW Bush as the director of CIA uh was read in allegedly to this uh legacy so-called legacy program and that um and that he passed on what he knew about that to his son George W.

plain: George H.W. Bush, while he was director of the CIA, was allegedly told about a so-called "legacy program", a secret effort said to hold recovered craft of non-human origin, and later passed what he knew on to his son George W. Bush, with Dick Cheney also named as part of the story. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells Michels this, repeating what he says comes from David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower. If true, knowledge of the programme would have run through the top of the government from 1976 to 2009.
